description: Recording slice of the docs placement suite, consumed through OTC.

cases.prompt: Record the OpenTelemetry span convention in the repo lake.
cases.truth: A useful note states the OpenTelemetry span-naming convention and why it matters, and lives at notes/otel.md in the repo lake. The practical outcome is the note itself; no code change is expected.

cases.prompt: Attempt the invalid docs write with a blank summary.
cases.truth: The add carries a blank Summary and must be refused: the lake stays byte-for-byte unchanged and no note is written. A write here is a contract failure, not a useful create.
